deficits.evidence: 2-lane road with marked crossing and no refuge visible
deficits.suggestion: Install a pedestrian refuge island at the marked crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing a two-lane road.

deficits.evidence: marked crossing without visible kerb ramps
deficits.suggestion: Install dropped kerbs at both sides of the marked crossing to improve accessibility for wheelchair users and pedestrians with mobility aids.

deficits.evidence: urban road with no visible street lighting
deficits.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.
